exposure: Perinatal characteristics (e.g., hypertensive disorders of pregnancy)
outcome: Postpartum hemoglobin A1c levels (normoglycemia, prediabetes, controlled diabetes, uncontrolled diabetes)
cohort: The study included 34,171 individuals from the APPLE Cohort who had gestational diabetes between 2009 and 2011.
finding: Maternal sociodemographic and perinatal characteristics were associated with adverse transitions in postpartum A1c stages following gestational diabetes, with Black individuals and those with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy showing higher risks of progression to uncontrolled diabetes.
